A simple blog aggregator

You'll need postgres and go installed to run it

to install as a CLI just run 'go build' in the root directory of the project (the one with the go.mod in it) and then run 'go install' in the same directory
*if you want to change the command name you can change the name of the file generated by go build. I recommend something memorable like gator

commands (put after file name you chose to run, put more afterwards to add arguments):

reset

resets database


register

1 argument: username
registers new user and logs into it


users

Switches user to an already registered user


agg

1 argument: collection period (eg. 5s, 1m)
loops over 1 added feed every colleciton period and adds posts to the database


addfeed

2 arguments: feed name (no spaces) and feed url
adds new RSS feed to the database and follows it with current user 


feeds

lists all feeds added to the database


follow

1 argument: url
follows feed with given url


following

lists all followed feeds for current user


unfollow

1 argument: url
unfollows feed with given url


browse

1 argument (optional): number of posts listed
lists most recently published posts from followed feeds, default number is 2.
